broker_generic_csv.name: Generic CSV
broker_generic_csv.description: Import transactions from a generic CSV file. Auto-detects columns based on header names. Supports various date and number formats.

description.date_order: How a date such as 03/04/2025 is read in a generic CSV: the day first (3 April) or the month first (4 March). A date that cannot be read the first way is read the other way (25/12/2025 is always 25 December).
